name: Ätran - Långesjön
description: Ätran to Långesjön. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Dricksvatten Ätran / toilet: Fresh water available by the toilet in Ätran; official place text says the toilet is maintained by the road association and operates all year.
notes: Official page/API says 22 km/22000 m; GPX desc is Total: 21.3 km and computed geometry is 21.293 km; Naturkartan displays 20.0 km; route apps vary around 19.8-21.27 km.

GPX/API geo_json/Naturkartan start at Ätran 57.121682,12.948858 and end at Långesjön 57.0368,13.011827. API line.geometry and OSM relation preserve older Eseredssjön-style endpoints and different lengths.
Current official name is Ätran - Långesjön, while Eseredssjön - Långesjön persists across several secondary/public sources.

Swedish page says there is now also a shelter in Krogsered by Lyngsjön, and places API/Naturkartan/Falkenberg corroborate the shelter. English accommodation text only mentions Eseredssjön and Långesjön.
Section-level prose implies shelters have fireplace/dry toilet/bin, while Krogsered place/Naturkartan records put the toilet at Lyngsjön badplats about 350 m away and water at Krogsered church.
The strongest negative maintenance/signage report is from 2016 and may be stale; no later exact-section report confirms ongoing marking/maintenance problems.

facilities.name: Hållplats Ätran
facilities.description: Official Hallandsleden public-transport point in central Ätran next to services and the stage start/end. Use commuteAccess for direct endpoint transit.

facilities.name: Lanthandlaren i Ätran / Ätrans Lanthandel
facilities.description: Well-stocked grocery at the square in central Ätran, directly by the route start. Verify opening hours/current operation before public display.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Ätran / toilet
facilities.description: Fresh water available by the toilet in Ätran; official place text says the toilet is maintained by the road association and operates all year.

facilities.name: Ätrans Turist & Fritid
facilities.description: Lodging/service/activity cluster beside Eseredssjön and Hallandsleden near Ätran. Verify current booking/services before public lodging display.

facilities.name: Eseredssjöns badplats
facilities.description: Bathing area in Ätran/Eseredssjön with bridge, tables/benches and grill place according to official place text.

facilities.name: Morfars Glänta
facilities.description: Rest/POI area between the bathing place and Eseredssjön shelter, developed from a 2025 local design process according to official place text.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Eseredssjön / Eseredssjöns vindskydd
facilities.description: Lakeside campsite with shelter for 4-5 adults, fireplace, firewood storage and dry toilet according to official place text and local corroboration. Firewood availability is dynamic and no potable water is verified at the shelter.

facilities.name: Krogsereds kyrka
facilities.description: Krogsered stone church, rebuilt after the 1924 fire; official place text says an earlier church probably existed from the 1200s.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Krogsered / Vindskydd, Krogsered
facilities.description: Shelter/rest area by Lyngsjön between Ätran and Långesjön, with shelter for 4-5 people and fireplace with seating. Official Swedish page says this is a newer/current shelter; English accommodation text omits it. Place/Naturkartan records say toilet is at Lyngsjön badplats about 350 m away and drinking water is at Krogsered church; do not attach those components directly to this shelter.

facilities.name: Lyngsjöns badplats i Krogsered
facilities.description: Bathing/rest cluster at Lyngsjön with grill place and dry toilet. Falkenberg confirms toilet, rubbish bins, grill spots and shelter context at the bathing area.

facilities.name: Brännvinsgölen
facilities.description: Small lake/legend site. Official place text explains stories behind the name, including a priest stopping for a drink and another tale about a spilled barrel.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Långesjön / Långesjöns vindskydd
facilities.description: Very scenic endpoint rest area/campsite with shelter for 4-5 people, fireplace and dry toilet according to official/Naturkartan/Hylte sources. No direct public transport or public parking verified at the site. Firewood status should be treated as dynamic; 2016 field report found no firewood then, but that is stale.
